title: Unsupervised sentiment neuron
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: We’ve developed an unsupervised system which learns an excellent representation of sentiment, despite being trained only to predict the next character in the text of Amazon reviews...
body:
We’ve developed an unsupervised system which learns an excellent representation of sentiment, despite being trained only to predict the next character in the text of Amazon reviews.

### Official Announcement
